title: Sudden Sensorineural Hearing Loss: Recognition and Urgent Referral
subject: ENT
preview: Sudden sensorineural hearing loss is an otologic urgency and may be mistaken for earwax or middle-ear disease.
quickRevision: Sudden sensorineural hearing loss is an otologic urgency and may be mistaken for earwax or middle-ear disease.
Prompt audiometry and specialist assessment improve diagnostic and treatment decision-making.
Consider associated neurologic signs that might indicate a central cause.

sections.title: Recognize the core pattern
points: Sudden sensorineural hearing loss is an otologic urgency and may be mistaken for earwax or middle-ear disease.
Use otoscopy and bedside Weber/Rinne assessment to help distinguish conductive from sensorineural impairment.

sections.title: Clinical examination and interpretation
points: Prompt audiometry and specialist assessment improve diagnostic and treatment decision-making.
Consider associated neurologic signs that might indicate a central cause.

sections.title: Exam trap — avoid this mistake
points: Do not delay referral for sudden unexplained hearing loss with a normal-looking ear canal.
